6f23c45dffe1.text: And the piano player? You want to hang him on me too? Reyes owed money to every shark in the harbor. I read the file. Maureen showed me.
6f23c45dffe1.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

3dbd6829ee6d.speaker: brenner
3dbd6829ee6d.text: Let me tell you how this city works, Ray, since nobody told you in twenty-six years. A city is a deal.
3dbd6829ee6d.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

c3d2e24d0fc7.speaker: brenner
c3d2e24d0fc7.text: Every street you drive on, somebody got paid to put it there. Harlan builds towers. Ted votes for towers. The towers get built, the city collects the taxes, the taxes pay your salary.
c3d2e24d0fc7.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

3060c70b4735.speaker: brenner
3060c70b4735.text: The piano player tried to cut himself a slice of that and the slice cut back.
3060c70b4735.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

660775daa3e8.speaker: brenner
660775daa3e8.text: Maureen? I taught her to drive a black-and-white. I wrote her letter for detective. I carried her through two shootings and a divorce.
660775daa3e8.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

21a36144a03f.speaker: brenner
21a36144a03f.text: If this goes where you want it to go, she goes with me. You want that on your board?
21a36144a03f.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

939fbb2514b0.speaker: brenner
939fbb2514b0.text: Or. Harlan needs a head of security, a real one, not an old man who drives. Two-fifty a year, a car, a pension on top of your pension.
939fbb2514b0.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

d6c677c83ccf.speaker: brenner
d6c677c83ccf.text: You'd sleep nights, Ray. You haven't slept nights in eight years.
d6c677c83ccf.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

cafe77e43908.speaker: brenner
cafe77e43908.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

da5d10ccde82.speaker: brenner
da5d10ccde82.text: Less than he thought. He wouldn't sell his lease, and he wouldn't tell me what the kid left him. He just kept saying, "A tab."
da5d10ccde82.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

26458c703ead.speaker: brenner
26458c703ead.text: I know her better than you do. I know what she'd do to keep her badge. I taught her.
26458c703ead.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

29237b8f0eb1.speaker: brenner
29237b8f0eb1.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

3e96421d06c7.speaker: brenner
3e96421d06c7.text: Whatever goes in here doesn't come back up. I've been told.
3e96421d06c7.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

d0a542902fd0.speaker: brenner
d0a542902fd0.text: I was a cop for thirty years and a civilian for seventeen, son. I'm better at the second one.
d0a542902fd0.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

f551f1b55fb0.speaker: brenner
f551f1b55fb0.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

2c87ab6fc0eb.speaker: brenner
2c87ab6fc0eb.text: A loan shark and a doorman. Who's going to believe them?
2c87ab6fc0eb.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

186212370606.speaker: brenner
186212370606.text: (the gun dips an inch) Leave her out of it.
186212370606.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

9c5d71bd1d95.speaker: brenner
9c5d71bd1d95.text: Danny was a blackmailer. He named his price.
9c5d71bd1d95.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

869ef2dadfd6.speaker: brenner
869ef2dadfd6.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

ef8deae92f7e.speaker: brenner
ef8deae92f7e.text: He wouldn't tell me anything. He just kept saying, "A tab." Like it was a joke.
ef8deae92f7e.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

5827b809571d.speaker: brenner
5827b809571d.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

77d7728f5490.speaker: brenner
77d7728f5490.text: I did. Muzzle down, cylinder out, rounds in your palm. She was the best I ever had.
77d7728f5490.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

3c743872b336.speaker: brenner
3c743872b336.text: Muzzle down. Cylinder out. Rounds in your palm.
3c743872b336.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

cb7101f4de54.speaker: brenner
cb7101f4de54.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

e1a31c285dda.speaker: brenner
e1a31c285dda.text: You think a drive full of piano music stops a forty-story building? Harlan's lawyers bill more an hour than you make in a week.
e1a31c285dda.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

0a440151d71f.speaker: brenner
0a440151d71f.text: Kessler. The coffee was a peace offering. I meant it.
0a440151d71f.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

f69e24933567.speaker: ray
f69e24933567.text: Pier 9. The ocean still smells like diesel and money. At this hour you can see which is which.

cbebc439f53f.speaker: ray
cbebc439f53f.text: Tiny, in his chair, with the radio. The sign.

be60d4899afd.speaker: ray
be60d4899afd.text: In a few minutes. Stay in your chair, Tiny, whatever happens.

beca2396de16.speaker: ray
beca2396de16.text: KJAZZ. Somebody's playing 'Round Midnight. Not as good as Danny did it.

9a51a4a4d4d3.speaker: ray
9a51a4a4d4d3.text: Vance in the green door, an overcoat over the cardigan, holding his tea like a weapon.

d887c1664415.speaker: ray
d887c1664415.text: An iron bollard at the end of the pier. A good place to put something down and wait.

111e4da34642.speaker: ray
111e4da34642.text: That's where he left me a coffee.

2d409fd307a2.speaker: ray
2d409fd307a2.text: Tiny and Vance know their places. Then I wait at the end of the pier.

0dcd1b6c1343.speaker: ray
0dcd1b6c1343.text: Walter Brenner. Six-three in an old belted raincoat, shoes like a parade.

5db7bee31e24.speaker: ray
5db7bee31e24.text: He looks like somebody's grandfather. He is somebody's grandfather.

05f14f306faf.speaker: ray
05f14f306faf.text: Walt Brenner, over the hood of his boss's car.

36864afbbcad.speaker: ray
36864afbbcad.text: Anything you want to say, Walt, save it for a lawyer.

a5fd0dc1366e.speaker: ray
a5fd0dc1366e.text: A long gray car. Preacher saw it stop on the Fletcher Drive bridge.

395293cdb8b1.speaker: ray
395293cdb8b1.text: A gray Lincoln Town Car. Long, clean, and somebody else's.

e0973ecf6d3d.speaker: ray
e0973ecf6d3d.text: It's not my car. I'll let the lab drive it.

116ec453b013.speaker: ray
116ec453b013.text: The harbor's got enough of Danny's things.

1d6d552cd27c.speaker: ray
1d6d552cd27c.text: Black water going pink. Whatever goes in here doesn't come back up.

de8b742a6123.speaker: ray
de8b742a6123.text: Cold. Tiny's taking the morning off.

90c574e54de3.speaker: ray
90c574e54de3.text: The boat hook, back where it belongs. Tiny counts.

7a60314966ce.speaker: ray
7a60314966ce.text: I've fished enough out of this pier.

aa77f99bc430.speaker: ray
aa77f99bc430.text: The gantry crane, red lights still blinking, though the sky's doing that job now.

54091edaf9b9.speaker: ray
54091edaf9b9.text: Boxes from Busan and Shenzhen, pink in the dawn.

b879178e2586.speaker: ray
b879178e2586.text: HARBOR MARINE SALVAGE. Vance's front, and his back.

6bdafa25b890.speaker: ray
6bdafa25b890.text: My car, looking worse in daylight.

6c767d30393f.speaker: ray
6c767d30393f.text: I'm not leaving. This is where it ends.

5d37d37b3e78.speaker: ray
5d37d37b3e78.text: Sunrise in twenty minutes. He'll be early. Cops are always early to the things that scare them.

7ff19b27014b.speaker: ray
7ff19b27014b.text: Headlights between the containers, pale against the dawn. A long gray Lincoln rolls down slowly and stops. The engine runs a moment, then quits.

69e8ea6debe3.speaker: ray
69e8ea6debe3.text: He carries two paper cups of coffee. He walks to me without hurrying and sets one on the bollard beside the phone.

e14637e8194c.speaker: ray
e14637e8194c.text: Let's see what you've got, Walt.

cfeb49a6c987.speaker: ray
cfeb49a6c987.text: An hour after Danny went down, Harlan's office booked you a Glide on the company account, Blue Note to Pryce Tower.

90126ebcedf7.speaker: ray
90126ebcedf7.text: Your driver gave you one star. He wrote that you smelled like gun oil.

4de958ecda60.speaker: ray
4de958ecda60.text: Kenji had a camera on his back seat. November's card. You, at twelve past one, wiping down a revolver, with a phone in a cracked case with a Blue Note sticker in your lap.

ae73b55b1c4e.speaker: ray
ae73b55b1c4e.text: You handed out cards on that block last Thursday. Security consultant, Pryce Development. "Empty by Christmas. The jazz club too."

08f0e6cfecc2.speaker: ray
08f0e6cfecc2.text: Your boss threw a party for Ted Haskell last night and drew a forty-story lobby where the Blue Note is.

9a61f4a9eba3.speaker: ray
9a61f4a9eba3.text: A long gray car stopped on the Fletcher Drive bridge Tuesday after three, and a big man in an old cop's coat threw something into the reeds. I fished it out tonight.

3691d2062ebf.speaker: ray
3691d2062ebf.text: Tuesday night you stood inside Danny's tape for an hour with an old ID and a tray of coffee, asking my uniforms if they'd found his phone. Officer Park logs everybody.

8a7f85d289c1.speaker: ray
8a7f85d289c1.text: You came back to see what you'd missed.

d8941a910c39.speaker: ray
d8941a910c39.text: You signed in to see Maureen at one-twenty. At one-thirty you heard her half of my call, and her half had Sal Moretti's name in it.

922796b57a48.speaker: ray
922796b57a48.text: When she hung up, you asked, the way an old cop asks, and she told you the rest: the knock, and the girl who gave it to me.

c55136369af8.speaker: ray
c55136369af8.text: At ten to two she went to the copier, and you picked up her desk phone and called Nina Alvarez. You told her you were my partner. You called her "young lady." You got Danny's knock.

b88e8e3284d9.speaker: ray
b88e8e3284d9.text: Otis has you on his log, and Nina's phone has Maureen's number at one fifty-two.

5b0b26acfb49.speaker: ray
5b0b26acfb49.text: Three-twenty. W.B., club soda, no charge. Sal Moretti wrote down every drink he ever poured, and he wrote you down so somebody would find you.

12b2f6cfc809.speaker: ray
12b2f6cfc809.text: And Dr. Shah says Sal died from a bar-arm choke, from behind. The department banned it in 1982. You came on in 1979.

df3bdb87e520.speaker: ray
df3bdb87e520.text: Brenner turns and looks at Vance for the first time. Then at Tiny.

16e253c60779.speaker: ray
16e253c60779.text: Tuesday night, eleven o'clock, a private booking in the back booth at the Blue Note. Two eighteen-year-old Scotches and a club soda. Harlan Pryce, Ted Haskell, and you.

b4a06b54b414.speaker: ray
b4a06b54b414.text: Danny was playing 'Round Midnight ten feet away, and his phone was recording. "You don't pay a man like that three times, Harlan. You pay him once."

b1d1b9a5544f.speaker: ray
b1d1b9a5544f.text: I pick Danny's phone up off the bollard and put it in his hand. He weighs it, looks at the Blue Note sticker, and flicks it out over the water.

4253656bb702.speaker: ray
4253656bb702.text: That's the second time you've thrown him in the water.

9a26434c5f85.speaker: ray
9a26434c5f85.text: It was dead before you threw it in the river, Walt. Danny's song wasn't on it. It went up to the cloud the second he stopped playing, and now it's in a place you'll never get to.

30866a711c3d.speaker: ray
30866a711c3d.text: He sets his coffee down on the bollard, very carefully. When his hand comes back out of his raincoat it has a .38 in it, held low and steady, the way they taught it in 1979.

e18bda9723ca.speaker: ray
e18bda9723ca.text: She keeps your picture in her desk drawer, Walt. Right now she's going over a briefing she copied while you used her phone.

2b64c306659e.speaker: ray
2b64c306659e.text: You pull that trigger and she's the one who reads my name on the board.

3709834b5811.speaker: ray
3709834b5811.text: Sal opened his door to a dead man's knock and poured you a club soda on the house. Then he wrote it down, because that's who he was.

88dfd9130a93.speaker: ray
88dfd9130a93.text: You killed the only man on that block who kept honest books.

dbc8dde2811f.speaker: ray
dbc8dde2811f.text: It was. You were the punch line.

177ae1c83408.speaker: ray
177ae1c83408.text: You came alone because you didn't want Harlan to know you'd left a loose end.

f21bea80db54.speaker: ray
f21bea80db54.text: He'll be at his desk at nine like nothing happened. He'll have a new driver by lunch.

e477b95c8180.speaker: ray
e477b95c8180.text: He looks past me at the gray Lincoln, then at the sun coming up behind the crane. He points the muzzle at the concrete, swings the cylinder out, and tips six rounds into his palm.

0ada82aef7c8.speaker: ray
0ada82aef7c8.text: He sets the empty revolver on the bollard next to my coffee, and the rounds beside it, in a neat row.

ca1a06983a82.speaker: ray
ca1a06983a82.text: Tell her yourself. You'll see her in court.

3cbd4bdc94a9.speaker: ray
3cbd4bdc94a9.text: Go ahead, Walt. Do it in front of everybody. A loan shark, a doorman, and the sun.

9154631ea411.speaker: ray
9154631ea411.text: He raises the .38 to my face. Behind him Tiny stands up out of his chair, and the chair scrapes on the concrete. Brenner half turns toward the sound.

bc4c5c06cf25.speaker: ray
bc4c5c06cf25.text: Tiny's hand closes over his wrist. The shot goes into the sky; the gulls come off the containers all at once.

95bb660d5807.speaker: ray
95bb660d5807.text: Tiny folds Brenner over the hood of the Lincoln like a man folding a towel.

45c03763dfd4.speaker: ray
45c03763dfd4.text: Walter Brenner, you're under arrest for the murders of Salvatore Moretti and Daniel Reyes.

8dd2fe1a4070.speaker: ray
8dd2fe1a4070.text: Anything you want to say, I'd save it for a lawyer, and get a good one. Harlan's will be busy.

0c120ec6621f.speaker: ray
0c120ec6621f.text: A .38. Shah will want to introduce it to Danny.

2f7e1d7add73.speaker: ray
2f7e1d7add73.text: A patrol car with Harbor Division markings rolls down the pier with no lights and no siren, the way Otis promised, and two uniforms get out.

bebce84f4917.speaker: ray
bebce84f4917.text: Then it'll be a long week.

310c9522704e.speaker: ray
310c9522704e.text: I know. That's the worst part.

2a2ea34a2333.speaker: ray
2a2ea34a2333.text: He says nothing. He looks straight ahead.

936585e3a345.speaker: ray
936585e3a345.text: The patrol car pulls away between the containers.

ba6ba8886c4f.speaker: ray
ba6ba8886c4f.text: That's him, Tiny. That's who did Danny.

7f5c39a5040d.speaker: ray
7f5c39a5040d.text: I know. I heard him. Tuesday. You weren't in, so he played it anyway.

6f8db2576df3.speaker: ray
6f8db2576df3.text: Tiny sits back down. He turns the radio up.

cd21c987e7f8.speaker: tiny
cd21c987e7f8.text: Detective. You said you'd come tell me.

f83a1fe55a2e.speaker: tiny
f83a1fe55a2e.text: He played 'Round Midnight for me. Without me asking.

805e88cbe4d9.speaker: vance
805e88cbe4d9.text: One of three. He only ever paid the first.

b1080f81add2.speaker: vance
b1080f81add2.text: We're square, Detective. Danny paid his debts. So do I.

bd0fcb9ecea4.speaker: vance
bd0fcb9ecea4.text: Then we're less crooked than we were. In my business that's a good morning.

50771f41c8c0.speaker: vance
50771f41c8c0.text: Detective. You look like a man who hasn't slept, and has decided not to.

524b4dceb846.speaker: vance
524b4dceb846.text: Don't thank me. I don't like men who telephone and ask about my clients. It's bad manners and worse for business.

5770261bc5ba.speaker: vance
5770261bc5ba.text: You asked me that before. This morning I get to hear the voice twice.

175cce17574b.speaker: vance
175cce17574b.text: I'll know his voice. I never forget a voice I disliked.

16a289c89091.speaker: vance
16a289c89091.text: I've stayed out of sight for forty years, Detective. It's my one real talent.

588ea2c6d277.speaker: vance
588ea2c6d277.text: And I keep my .45 for people who want to be romantic.

6091e10653f4.speaker: vance
6091e10653f4.text: Dead men don't pay, Mr. Brenner. Danny paid me. All of it, Tuesday afternoon.

46fe4cc0b000.speaker: vance
46fe4cc0b000.text: And I know your voice. You telephoned me Wednesday to ask.

76ba46ee739c.speaker: vance
76ba46ee739c.text: A revolver, Mr. Brenner. I did tell the detective. They're for people who want to be romantic about it.

a91d24a11fb1.speaker: doyle
a91d24a11fb1.text: Harbor Division just booked Walt Brenner for two homicides on your say-so. Walt. Ray, have you lost your mind?

16b81895f801.speaker: doyle
16b81895f801.text: (very quietly) He was in my office. He brought coffee.

b603bc83651f.speaker: doyle
b603bc83651f.text: Give me the hard version, Ray. The one the captain's going to give me.

5c50baf3ffe4.speaker: doyle
5c50baf3ffe4.text: He brought me coffee. He asked how my night was going. And I told him about your bartender like it was gossip. Like it was nothing.

63f4ec3f10cd.speaker: doyle
63f4ec3f10cd.text: Not like this. Not like this, Ray.

7a052195a00c.speaker: doyle
7a052195a00c.text: Captain. It's Doyle. No, sir, it can't wait until eight.

c7e09ca74d59.speaker: doyle
c7e09ca74d59.text: Yes, sir. I'll be the one testifying.

9926428329f1.speaker: doyle
9926428329f1.text: The call, the copier, all of it. It'll cost me.

ce4b5fc58d36.speaker: doyle
ce4b5fc58d36.text: I know. I'll carry the box. You carry the drive, and you don't let go of it until the DA signs for it in front of both of us.

c07f787314fb.speaker: doyle
c07f787314fb.text: Go home after, Ray. That's not an order. I don't think I get to give you those this morning.

063ae96b0ef2.speaker: doyle
063ae96b0ef2.text: Give me the drive, Ray. I'll take it to IA myself, today, properly. We do this by the book.

7399c231447c.speaker: doyle
7399c231447c.text: Walt killed a bartender. That we can prove, and that's what he'll go down for.

ad827721d5e3.speaker: doyle
ad827721d5e3.text: Danny was a blackmailer who got shot in an alley. I'm sorry, Ray. That's what the captain will see.

b8a8668d5835.speaker: mara
b8a8668d5835.text: You know what this does to you.

98942294002e.speaker: mara
98942294002e.text: When I've made my copy, the drive goes to the DA. I'll walk it over myself.

cd3c383061d8.speaker: mara
cd3c383061d8.text: It goes up at noon. They'll know where it came from.

d31f8dc28508.speaker: okafor
d31f8dc28508.text: You understand this goes through every desk in your building. Including your lieutenant's.

b70f84b829ab.speaker: okafor
b70f84b829ab.text: It'll be slow. Men like Pryce make everything slow.

999ed9b98ae1.speaker: okafor
999ed9b98ae1.text: (signing the chain-of-custody form) Go home, Detective. You'll be hearing from us more than you'd like.

c3a9cf27ee0e.speaker: ray
c3a9cf27ee0e.text: One drive. The original's frozen at Takes until somebody asks a judge for it, and whoever gets this decides whether anybody asks.

94fe694930eb.speaker: ray
94fe694930eb.text: Danny's song on a piece of plastic the size of a stick of gum.

adb3e3a990cd.speaker: ray
adb3e3a990cd.text: Whoever I hand it to decides what Danny Reyes was worth. The department. The law. The paper.

fc262822e3ce.speaker: ray
fc262822e3ce.text: The end of the pier. The sun's on the water now.

5b41a8869cd7.speaker: ray
5b41a8869cd7.text: Gold on the water. The harbor doesn't know what it's holding.

50b6a8af5bfe.speaker: ray
50b6a8af5bfe.text: Tiny, the radio turned up. He hasn't looked away from the water.

8bdfe3747176.speaker: ray
8bdfe3747176.text: Vance in his doorway, finishing his tea, watching the morning like it owes him money.

d3d6ef59f2cb.speaker: ray
d3d6ef59f2cb.text: Brenner's Lincoln, waiting for the lab's tow truck. It'll be the cleanest thing in the impound lot.

4ccd7c51e142.speaker: ray
4ccd7c51e142.text: My car. It's seen the whole night. It looks it.

e25c433108ba.speaker: ray
e25c433108ba.text: The pier in daylight. Everything looks smaller than it did at one in the morning.

ea8e8eea5b0f.speaker: ray
ea8e8eea5b0f.text: Thirty more seconds of nobody knowing.

68de029778a2.speaker: ray
68de029778a2.text: Lieutenant. Come to Pier 9. Bring the briefing for the captain. You'll want to rewrite it.

5f75d77afe6a.speaker: ray
5f75d77afe6a.text: A dark sedan comes down the pier. Lt. Maureen Doyle: a good wool coat, her hair pinned up for a meeting at eight, a face that hasn't slept.

473dca62630b.speaker: ray
473dca62630b.text: I found it. It was in a piano.

50d3adf37c94.speaker: ray
50d3adf37c94.text: I open Danny's box on the hood of my car and lay it out, and give her the gist: the one-thirty call, the copier, the one fifty-two call to Nina, the knock, Sal, the take.

8a8b6c519e5b.speaker: ray
8a8b6c519e5b.text: "Walter Brenner, LAPD, retired. Security Consultant, Pryce Development." He handed these out on the Blue Note's block last Thursday.

9648785c6f49.speaker: ray
9648785c6f49.text: Empty by Christmas, the jazz club too.

d4d158bc08a5.speaker: ray
d4d158bc08a5.text: Wednesday, ten past one. A Glide from the Blue Note to Pryce Tower, billed to Pryce Development's business account. Rider: Walt B.

0a47f7b1078b.speaker: ray
0a47f7b1078b.text: The driver gave him one star and wrote that he smelled like gun oil. An hour after Danny went down, Walt went straight to the boss, on the boss's account.

a7353a33270e.speaker: ray
a7353a33270e.text: And the driver's back-seat camera has him in that car holding Danny's phone.

5920a7708ddf.speaker: ray
5920a7708ddf.text: Pryce threw him a party last night. "Friends of Ted Haskell." Look inside. They've drawn a lobby where the Blue Note is.

6851e40249a6.speaker: ray
6851e40249a6.text: The vote's next Wednesday, and he's the swing. His own chief of staff told me so, right before he asked for a lawyer.

fe88357ce332.speaker: ray
fe88357ce332.text: Doyle looks at the hood of the car for a long time. The ride receipt, the card, the invitation, the envelope, the string still knotted to the pins.

77ccbe093830.speaker: ray
77ccbe093830.text: You told me everything closes eventually.

b3f88f7bc04e.speaker: ray
b3f88f7bc04e.text: I had a name and a voice. I didn't have a single piece of paper with Walt and Pryce on it.

69f1ffd2cb82.speaker: ray
69f1ffd2cb82.text: I couldn't put Walt with Pryce that night. Somewhere in a dead driver's app there was a receipt I never looked for.

048c1003f508.speaker: ray
048c1003f508.text: I had nothing with Pryce and Haskell on the same page. Somewhere up in Los Feliz there was a box of gift bags I walked past.

00505d8c39f6.speaker: ray
00505d8c39f6.text: I hold the evidence bag a moment longer than I should. Then I put it in her hand.

f9dc32873f99.speaker: ray
f9dc32873f99.text: She gets back in her car. I watch it go.

dfa16e6c2e76.speaker: ray
dfa16e6c2e76.text: She meant it. That's what I keep coming back to. She meant every word.

f8719c3fd382.speaker: ray
f8719c3fd382.text: Professional Standards Bureau? Detective Ray Kessler, Hollywood Homicide. I need to report a leak from a lieutenant's office.

587e0e3913b9.speaker: ray
587e0e3913b9.text: And I need a deputy DA from Public Integrity at Pier 9, San Pedro, before the sun's all the way up.

92f1e3d550ec.speaker: ray
92f1e3d550ec.text: Forty minutes later: two cars. Deputy DA Helen Okafor, a raincoat over gym clothes, and a silent IA sergeant with a camera.

d12fe83265b5.speaker: ray
d12fe83265b5.text: She reads the index card, listens to me, and holds out an evidence envelope for the drive. I hand her Ike's hash sheet with it.

9010eead6902.speaker: ray
9010eead6902.text: Frozen at Takes since five fifty-one. The lab sent a preservation letter. You'll want a warrant.

37079bdbf73c.speaker: ray
37079bdbf73c.text: Slow's fine. Slow is how things stay done.

5db4a7debad9.speaker: ray
5db4a7debad9.text: I take her card out of my coat and dial.

ed6eccea6723.speaker: ray
ed6eccea6723.text: Twenty-five minutes later her hatchback bumps down the pier. She listens to the take on her laptop, headphones on, twice, without a word. Then she takes them off.

34a965a3f70f.speaker: ray
34a965a3f70f.text: I know what it does to them.

b7a182dc92f8.speaker: ray
b7a182dc92f8.text: Five names on a board. Danny, Kenji, Gus, Owen, Sal. Nobody important stayed up for any of them.

432ee664a925.speaker: vance
432ee664a925.text: Go home, Detective. Even I'm going home.

a2a9bcc137af.speaker: mara
a2a9bcc137af.text: Detective Kessler? Mara Quist, the Times. I heard it on the scanner. Same bar as the piano player Tuesday. Is that a pattern?

ffa66cbac1f8.speaker: mara
ffa66cbac1f8.text: You'd be amazed how many stories start with that.

aa1a4791165e.speaker: mara
aa1a4791165e.text: You're the only detective in Hollywood who works nights on purpose. People talk about you. Not always kindly.

04c2593070b7.speaker: mara
04c2593070b7.text: I am home. I live on the scanner.

c15ac35646ee.speaker: mara
c15ac35646ee.text: When it's a pattern, call me. Not the press office. Me.

159b41c63d01.speaker: mara
159b41c63d01.text: City Hall. Who pays for whose vote. It's like homicide, but nobody ever gets caught.

cbcd2fc5e4d0.speaker: mara
cbcd2fc5e4d0.text: Hollywood Core. Pryce Development wants forty stories where this bar is. The council votes next Wednesday.

78595af0971f.speaker: mara
78595af0971f.text: Ted Haskell's the swing vote, and nobody can find out which way he swings. I've been on it a year. Nobody will talk to me.

5b2984811ed1.speaker: park
5b2984811ed1.text: Detective. Third time tonight. They should give us a punch card.

6950b5c44016.speaker: park
6950b5c44016.text: The porter found him at four thirty-one and called it in on the bar phone. I was two blocks away.

37d3717e2137.speaker: park
37d3717e2137.text: He's in the back room. Dr. Shah's with him.

719698797137.speaker: park
719698797137.text: Me. To check for a pulse. There wasn't one.

88eeaf841fce.speaker: park
88eeaf841fce.text: I'm sorry, Detective. Otis said you knew him.

aa771aab3d97.speaker: park
aa771aab3d97.text: The watch commander says suicide. Front door locked, back door locked, a man alone in his own bar with a rope.

1f51492ef9f5.speaker: park
1f51492ef9f5.text: I held his tape. Midnight to four, in the rain.

83023b41d8a8.speaker: park
83023b41d8a8.text: The usual. Two drunks and a man with a dog. And a retired cop. Big old-timer, white hair, belted raincoat.

899320939ea5.speaker: park
899320939ea5.text: He showed me his old ID and stood inside the tape with us for an hour like he never left the job. Brought us all coffee from the place on Cahuenga.

5d672bfa30d4.speaker: park
5d672bfa30d4.text: Whether we'd found the victim's phone. I said no. He said kids today lose everything. A car came for him around ten past one.

5d7515836d5a.speaker: park
5d7515836d5a.text: Walt something. He said everybody at Hollywood knows him. It's in my scene log. I log everybody inside my tape.

d86308aa2686.speaker: park
d86308aa2686.text: I'll keep the Times on the right side of the tape. She's very polite about ignoring me.

e01c27b35877.speaker: ray
e01c27b35877.text: Three hours ago I stood here and knocked like a dead man. Sal opened up.

a8dff7b23fb1.speaker: ray
a8dff7b23fb1.text: The neon's off. Eight years across the street, and I've never seen it off.

a32b3652b65a.speaker: ray
a32b3652b65a.text: Yellow tape from the lamp to the hydrant. It keeps out everyone who'd behave anyway.

352a513dcb04.speaker: ray
352a513dcb04.text: The door I talked through. It's open now. That's worse.

986e80e62ea3.speaker: ray
986e80e62ea3.text: Mara Quist, LA Times. Notebook dry under her coat. She's been up longer than me.

d79162483cc2.speaker: ray
d79162483cc2.text: She knows where I keep it.

3a1ca3847c46.speaker: ray
3a1ca3847c46.text: Officer Park. Third scene tonight, and her rain cape's still pressed.

6d8d9227e272.speaker: ray
6d8d9227e272.text: The porter. Sixties, a mop bucket, and a face that hasn't caught up with what it saw.

c7f0017bfa41.speaker: ray
c7f0017bfa41.text: The precinct. Room 214's one flight up. So's the lieutenant's office.

ba4fa211ac7b.speaker: ray
ba4fa211ac7b.text: The payphone. Three hours ago I put a dime in it and started all this.

338622ab93cd.speaker: ray
338622ab93cd.text: I've made my call. It cost more than a dime.

6acbf8837801.speaker: ray
6acbf8837801.text: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING. Applicant: Pryce Development. It was taped to the Blue Note's wall the whole time.

1a1a5f23e947.speaker: ray
1a1a5f23e947.text: It's somebody else's paperwork. For now.

f32d000790b3.speaker: ray
f32d000790b3.text: The dumpster where I found the matchbook. Seems like a week ago.

354ad47f9227.speaker: ray
354ad47f9227.text: Nothing in there tonight but rain.

8963e59b4403.speaker: ray
8963e59b4403.text: Where they found Danny on Tuesday. The back door to the Blue Note opens onto it.

e11dc54811fd.speaker: ray
e11dc54811fd.text: Locked from the inside. I'll go in the front.

3c8e6b2d453c.speaker: ray
3c8e6b2d453c.text: Shah's van. She beat me here. She always does.

c7fd1ff28760.speaker: ray
c7fd1ff28760.text: Park's unit, lights turning for nobody.

b02a4eda9182.speaker: ray
b02a4eda9182.text: Road flares, burning down in the wet. Somebody wanted the traffic to slow down for Sal. Nobody's driving.

3e3259d4a87c.speaker: ray
3e3259d4a87c.text: BLUE NOTE. Dark. I've never seen it dark.

0ebecc0be584.speaker: ray
0ebecc0be584.text: My car. Still wet, still dented.

980e50a1e88a.speaker: ray
980e50a1e88a.text: It's a bar. People keep dying near it.

61f320c4589a.speaker: ray
61f320c4589a.text: How do you know my name?

0fc225562f85.speaker: ray
0fc225562f85.text: What do you know about the block?

229a83b6582f.speaker: ray
229a83b6582f.text: Pryce Development. It was taped to the Blue Note's wall the whole time.

0dc0c9b810f5.speaker: ray
0dc0c9b810f5.text: Sal wrote down every drink he poured for thirty years. And he didn't leave a note.

96cb2ecd6436.speaker: ray
96cb2ecd6436.text: An old cop at a fresh scene, asking about the one thing that's missing.

cbc854232d90.speaker: ray
cbc854232d90.text: Somebody went out the front and pulled it shut behind him.

243ff103d078.speaker: ray
243ff103d078.text: Not yet. Whatever I need is on this block.

e6fc6c42da4e.speaker: ray
e6fc6c42da4e.text: Pier 9. Last time I drove down there, Danny was a debt.

01d212ead333.speaker: ray
01d212ead333.text: Sal's inside. So's whatever he left me.

dadfbcda6679.speaker: teo
dadfbcda6679.text: You're the detective from across the street. Sal said you came by. Through the door.

8e09a2b0969b.speaker: teo
8e09a2b0969b.text: He was scared after. He told me, "Teo, I talked." Like it was a sin.

4d4623088670.speaker: teo
4d4623088670.text: Four-thirty, like every morning. Nineteen years. We've been closed since Danny, but Sal said keep coming, we open again Saturday.

7243c832ac08.speaker: teo
7243c832ac08.text: I let myself in, I go to the back for the mop. And he was...

a9b727db0f03.speaker: teo
a9b727db0f03.text: I called 911 on the bar phone. Then I came out here. I haven't been able to go back in.

4bc2e97936f8.speaker: teo
4bc2e97936f8.text: It was on the latch. Just the latch. Sal threw the deadbolt every night, and the chain, and he checked it twice.

7249ebcf8cbe.speaker: teo
7249ebcf8cbe.text: Nineteen years, I never once came in on just the latch.

c6041b3d8a6f.speaker: teo
c6041b3d8a6f.text: He wrote everything down. Every drink, in the book by the register. Even mine, and I don't drink.

51ef23b0e5c2.speaker: teo
51ef23b0e5c2.text: "Teo, water, four thirty-five," every morning. He used to say, "If it isn't in the book, it didn't happen."

25aea7bb235a.speaker: teo
25aea7bb235a.text: I don't knock. I have a key. Since Tuesday Sal only opened that door to Danny's knock.

5f1bb35d07ba.speaker: teo
5f1bb35d07ba.text: He said, "Teo, if anybody knocks it any other way, I'm not home."

d4ededc72614.speaker: ray
d4ededc72614.text: Room 214. Five hours ago I pinned an envelope next to Danny and drew a question mark. Time to fill it in.

30d2f0ad4b1f.speaker: ray
30d2f0ad4b1f.text: Room 214. Whoever came for Sal knew he'd only open to Danny's knock. But he didn't know the knock. He had to call Nina for it.

74a01abd6d8b.speaker: ray
74a01abd6d8b.text: Danny knocked like that on Vance's door every Tuesday. Tiny and Vance had the rhythm and never needed to ask. This man had the rule and not the rhythm.

a852ffc16b11.speaker: ray
a852ffc16b11.text: I told somebody the rule. Who did I tell?

37e89e810d61.speaker: ray
37e89e810d61.text: The sky's gone the color of a dirty dime. Sunrise in an hour.

d0a03d48ac5d.speaker: ray
d0a03d48ac5d.text: Gray over the parking lot. The rain's thinking about stopping.

b296f0462cf7.speaker: ray
b296f0462cf7.text: Five to six. Five minutes until I'm off shift. Then I'm a civilian with a badge.

4d259cfbab73.speaker: ray
4d259cfbab73.text: Twenty past five. Forty minutes until I'm supposed to go home.

419603c00f0f.speaker: ray
419603c00f0f.text: Four corners and a hole in the middle where a piano player used to be.

7d67003a0659.speaker: ray
7d67003a0659.text: Danny in the middle, Sal beside him now, and a name on the back of an index card.

7e8b9705e080.speaker: ray
7e8b9705e080.text: Four corners and a middle. Danny's still in the middle, and now Sal is somewhere in it too.

61cdc0ddc74d.speaker: ray
61cdc0ddc74d.text: After I know what Danny had.

282b4ace0bd3.speaker: ray
282b4ace0bd3.text: Not yet. I need what Danny had.

d0f167ee6dd8.speaker: ray
d0f167ee6dd8.text: One call out, all night. One-thirty, to the lieutenant's office, one floor up.

1dffb872cb33.speaker: ray
1dffb872cb33.text: I told her about Sal, and the knock, and Nina.

cccfbe9e4a46.speaker: ray
cccfbe9e4a46.text: HOLLYWOOD STATION, INTERNAL. Every extension in the building.

1bc9d9841404.speaker: ray
1bc9d9841404.text: Every extension in the building. One of them made a call it shouldn't have.

ad562fc27f66.speaker: ray
ad562fc27f66.text: Three-two-three, five-five-five, oh-one-eight-six. The lieutenant's direct line.

348e22f453a3.speaker: ray
348e22f453a3.text: That's Nina's police number. One fifty-two, twenty-two minutes after I hung up on her.

0ba82718a338.speaker: ray
0ba82718a338.text: Maureen Doyle doesn't call waitresses at two in the morning. She doesn't call anybody. She has people for that.

80171a56e1a9.speaker: ray
80171a56e1a9.text: The lieutenant's direct line. Somebody else was holding it at one fifty-two.

eb5a625cd195.speaker: ray
eb5a625cd195.text: The lieutenant's line, at one fifty-two. And at one-thirty I was on it, telling her everything.

b76a685589e4.speaker: ray
b76a685589e4.text: I close my eyes and play the call back.

a2f6ac1e03aa.speaker: ray
a2f6ac1e03aa.text: One-thirty. Rain on the window. Her voice on the line, one floor up.

bf2379d7cf1c.speaker: ray
bf2379d7cf1c.text: She says that every time I call. It's always one-thirty somewhere.

ab38387b5f2f.speaker: ray
ab38387b5f2f.text: And I told her. Sal Moretti, the bartender.

85205cb6eb9c.speaker: ray
85205cb6eb9c.text: And I told her how he talks: through his door, if you knock right. Danny's knock. His girl Nina gave it to me. I said all of it.

557f063f673a.speaker: ray
557f063f673a.text: "Thanks, Walt. Black is fine." Muffled, away from the phone, right in the middle of it.

fdc96baf3421.speaker: ray
fdc96baf3421.text: Her favorite song. Not the line.

27d72c72f596.speaker: ray
27d72c72f596.text: There was somebody in her office at one-thirty in the morning, bringing her coffee and listening to her half of my call.

cc8c4d5308ad.speaker: ray
cc8c4d5308ad.text: Her half had Sal's name in it. The rest she could tell him after she hung up.

3f7f4d3cac2c.speaker: ray
3f7f4d3cac2c.text: Otis. I need a black-and-white at Pier 9, San Pedro, at a quarter to seven. Lights off. No radio.

f2745037ac64.speaker: ray
f2745037ac64.text: Otis. Who came up to see the lieutenant last night?

3fa7b6212ffe.speaker: ray
3fa7b6212ffe.text: Was she with him the whole time?

abb3180fa5b4.speaker: ray
abb3180fa5b4.text: Nothing yet. Don't write down that I asked.

978a0a8308f6.speaker: ray
978a0a8308f6.text: Walt B. A Glide from the Blue Note to Pryce Tower an hour after Danny died. One star. Gun oil. And Kenji had a camera on his back seat.

5671bc00d9c0.speaker: ray
5671bc00d9c0.text: Walter Brenner, LAPD, retired. Security consultant, Pryce Development.

66f907e0e6d1.speaker: ray
66f907e0e6d1.text: Park's old-timer at Danny's tape. An old ID, coffee from Cahuenga, and one question: did we find the phone.

d83246a865cd.speaker: ray
d83246a865cd.text: "He drives for some developer." Andre said Pryce's driver was a big old guy who used to be a cop.

68ab2e5b4572.speaker: ray
68ab2e5b4572.text: Maureen didn't make that call. She went to copy the captain's briefing, and the man who taught her to drive a black-and-white picked up her phone.

1918c8a4b257.speaker: ray
1918c8a4b257.text: She told him what I told her, because I told her, because she's my boss. That's how it works.

3048fe4430ba.speaker: ray
3048fe4430ba.text: Twenty-six years, and the first time I lied to a lieutenant it felt like the right thing. It felt like being sick. Both.

76c488c7dd66.speaker: ray
76c488c7dd66.text: Maybe. Give me ten minutes and a piano.

3cf89183e3bc.speaker: ray
3cf89183e3bc.text: One more thing. The rideshare case. Eleven dashcam cards came in from a freezer around three. Pull November. Wednesday, ten past one, the back-seat lens.

6070da51c977.speaker: ray
6070da51c977.text: Tiny. Ray Kessler. Friend of Danny's.

cbde02a16fd8.speaker: ray
cbde02a16fd8.text: I found him. I need your pier at sunrise, and I need Mr. Vance.

ec72f548db4e.speaker: ray
ec72f548db4e.text: You said a man telephoned you Wednesday, asking whether Danny paid you. You keep records, Mr. Vance.

3fb681de228d.speaker: ray
3fb681de228d.text: Did anyone else ask you about Danny this week?

1f41f1a687e9.speaker: ray
1f41f1a687e9.text: Same number as the card on Gus's desk.

5a91b56d9f36.speaker: ray
5a91b56d9f36.text: I'd like to meet him on your pier at sunrise. I'd like you there. Tiny too.

dad0c7d438a9.speaker: ray
dad0c7d438a9.text: I want witnesses who aren't anybody's.

932f505e6429.speaker: ray
932f505e6429.text: Otis can find me a patrol car nobody upstairs knows about.

8d27465c3b9d.speaker: ray
8d27465c3b9d.text: Thirty-one years behind a bar, and he opened the door one last time. Who for?

277bd71548c9.speaker: ray
277bd71548c9.text: Shah says he was dead before the rope. And he'd have had to fly to that pipe.

9c461c8db009.speaker: ray
9c461c8db009.text: Shah says he was dead before the rope.

c8514ce1a029.speaker: ray
c8514ce1a029.text: Nina was in a cooler with a paring knife, hiding from the man who did it. She couldn't put a bar-arm choke on a man if he lay down for her.

18ce60202964.speaker: ray
18ce60202964.text: Her phone made the call. She was at the copier when it did. And nobody taught that hold to anyone who joined in '96.

8f66e7aa2026.speaker: ray
8f66e7aa2026.text: Vance and Tiny heard Danny's knock every Tuesday. Whoever killed Sal had to call Nina to get it.

12674e917f52.speaker: ray
12674e917f52.text: The man who brought the coffee.

c4d35baadff1.speaker: ray
c4d35baadff1.text: Somebody pulled the trigger on Danny. Somebody else named the price. Who?

6b4925c556fd.speaker: ray
6b4925c556fd.text: Dead men don't pay, and Danny had paid.

9aa0a2fb490e.speaker: ray
9aa0a2fb490e.text: Nina had a plan for Lisbon. You don't kill the man who's buying the tickets.

e10428eab173.speaker: ray
e10428eab173.text: Maureen never heard of Danny Reyes until he was a file on her desk.

69d0249ab970.speaker: ray
69d0249ab970.text: Walt Brenner. He killed Danny for a price somebody else named, and he killed Sal for opening a door.

6b3b9638b3c5.speaker: ray
6b3b9638b3c5.text: A ride receipt, a business card and a party invitation. Three pieces of paper that hadn't been introduced. Now they're family.

330643e8d0ca.speaker: ray
330643e8d0ca.text: A string with gaps in it. Gaps are where lawyers live.

806b5b3e7f13.speaker: ray
806b5b3e7f13.text: No string. A name, a dead man's handwriting, and a song I haven't picked up yet.

506827ed6f1e.speaker: ray
506827ed6f1e.text: Danny's case goes in a box. Then I need a place, a witness, and a way to get Walt there.

a41ae3ae2fb1.speaker: ray
a41ae3ae2fb1.text: If I'm wrong about the next hour, somebody should find all of this in one box.

d77693d772ed.speaker: doyle
d77693d772ed.text: Ray. Otis says you're at the Blue Note.

92d2443ce6e8.speaker: doyle
92d2443ce6e8.text: I heard. Patrol says he hanged himself. I know you talked to him tonight. That's not on you.

df87fe9ba00c.speaker: doyle
df87fe9ba00c.text: Walt Brenner called me ten minutes ago. My old training officer; you've never met him. He listens to the scanner like it's a ballgame.

71149978eed5.speaker: doyle
71149978eed5.text: He heard the Blue Note call and asked if you were on it. He's worried about you. He says you sound like a man who's been up all night chasing a ghost.

2e8648d2e580.speaker: doyle
2e8648d2e580.text: He's heard me talk about you. That's worse. Tell me you're going home at six.

8c155fd530de.speaker: doyle
8c155fd530de.text: That's the first time you've ever listened to me.

c5de2d8ea032.speaker: doyle
c5de2d8ea032.text: I see the captain at eight. Get some sleep. *click*

72edc4a95475.speaker: otis
72edc4a95475.text: Then I don't either. Harbor Division owes me a favor from 2011. I'll call it in myself.

57817e77f9b7.speaker: otis
57817e77f9b7.text: Front desk. Your car's called in, Ray. Lights off, no radio, quarter to seven. I don't know a thing.

966b6693eb2b.speaker: otis
966b6693eb2b.text: Front desk. I've lost a page, Ray. Like I said.

dee28afcba6d.speaker: otis
dee28afcba6d.text: Front desk. Ray, I'm sorry about Sal.

3f092786a1eb.speaker: otis
3f092786a1eb.text: (pages turning) One visitor after midnight. In at one-twenty, out at two-oh-five. Walter Brenner.

2688589ac5c5.speaker: otis
2688589ac5c5.text: Retired, showed me his old ID and signed in like a civilian. He brought the lieutenant a coffee from the place on Cahuenga, and he brought me one too. Black.

4fbd198dcf23.speaker: otis
4fbd198dcf23.text: Nobody ever brings the desk a coffee.

e7a3dc0099e0.speaker: otis
e7a3dc0099e0.text: Old-timer. Rampart, way back. He was her training officer. She thinks the world of him. He drives for some developer now. Says the hours are better than ours.

9e8fe308b4ab.speaker: otis
9e8fe308b4ab.text: Funny you ask. I've got her hallway on my monitor. Ten to two she went down to the copier with a stack the size of a phone book. The captain's briefing.

e26f089c76f0.speaker: otis
e26f089c76f0.text: Six, seven minutes. He stayed in her office.

d86c1dc2d01c.speaker: otis
d86c1dc2d01c.text: With the coffee. Ray, what's this about?

b9e0889ffac3.speaker: otis
b9e0889ffac3.text: I write everything down, Ray. But I've been known to lose a page.

ab1b7293d7b2.speaker: ike
ab1b7293d7b2.text: Kessler. You said one hour. It's been fifty minutes. I'm a man of my word.

d0c9cc64b009.speaker: ike
d0c9cc64b009.text: The phone's soup, like I said. But your piano player recorded every set on an app called Takes. Every take uploads to the cloud the second you hit stop.

0e1df8712233.speaker: ike
0e1df8712233.text: Account name "reyes.keys." Last upload: Tuesday, eleven fifty-two p.m.

bc5ea901861a.speaker: ike
bc5ea901861a.text: His mother in Fresno is next of kin. She gave written consent ten minutes ago, so this is legal, and I'd like to keep it that way.

b7b534b4ce05.speaker: ike
b7b534b4ce05.text: I can get in through account recovery, but it wants the password, and he left himself a hint. Quote: "the knock, the way I play it."

1d0021a23d78.speaker: ike
1d0021a23d78.text: Three wrong tries and it locks for a day. You know what that means?

551bb3528171.speaker: ike
551bb3528171.text: You know what my job is, right? It's this. Fine.

3aaeefc5f864.speaker: vance
3aaeefc5f864.text: Detective. Dawn is an unchristian hour.

37e76a15e40e.speaker: vance
37e76a15e40e.text: A man telephoned Wednesday. He wanted to know if Danny had paid me, and in what. He talked like a cop who'd stopped being one.

f59660c1092c.speaker: vance
f59660c1092c.text: I keep everyone's number. It's the only way to be sure of people.

3dcc9aabc118.speaker: vance
3dcc9aabc118.text: Two-one-three, five-five-five, oh-one-six-three. A cell telephone. A cop's voice and a civilian's manners.

adae77143ac3.speaker: vance
adae77143ac3.text: You want witnesses who aren't police.

0f27e60c25d1.speaker: vance
0f27e60c25d1.text: Danny paid his debts, Detective. I like to think I pay mine. Sunrise.

1ca3abfef9d4.speaker: tiny
1ca3abfef9d4.text: Harbor Marine. Sunrise, Detective. Mr. Vance doesn't like to be asked twice.

8595f05947a5.speaker: ray
8595f05947a5.text: That's how he got the knock. Put him in the bar.

d4dbef0fa6a8.speaker: ray
d4dbef0fa6a8.text: That puts him at Sal's bar. First, how he got in.

51f815bc8f1f.speaker: ray
51f815bc8f1f.text: That's Maureen's phone. Who was holding it?

8c9425e24c9e.speaker: ray
8c9425e24c9e.text: That's when the knock got out. Not who took it.

c59b8eed5349.speaker: ray
c59b8eed5349.text: Walt was in the room. Was he alone with the phone?

854f57e8a59d.speaker: ray
854f57e8a59d.text: That's what I told. Pin who listened.

c2e2fcee986c.speaker: ray
c2e2fcee986c.text: That's how. Put him in the room.

f20af8806656.speaker: ray
f20af8806656.text: Somebody washed a glass. Whose name goes with it?

201b17c7832b.speaker: ray
201b17c7832b.text: Nina heard a voice. She never saw a face.

970b0c7992ee.speaker: ray
970b0c7992ee.text: That's how he left. Pin him arriving.

0bb77609e13c.speaker: ray
0bb77609e13c.text: That proves it wasn't Sal. It doesn't prove it was Walt.

bdd9cc8b9b77.speaker: ray
bdd9cc8b9b77.text: That's why Pryce wanted him gone. Not who came.

570b42373bd1.speaker: ray
570b42373bd1.text: That's what Danny had. First, what it was costing them.

5e0127c230ef.speaker: ray
5e0127c230ef.text: That's the bill. First, what Danny had.

21df25f77228.speaker: ray
21df25f77228.text: That's who sat there. Pin what they said.

d8764c1f28bd.speaker: ray
d8764c1f28bd.text: He recorded a lot of sets. Pin the one that mattered.

3f5929c2c9c8.speaker: ray
3f5929c2c9c8.text: That says he had money. What says there was more coming?

2c4071fdf960.speaker: ray
2c4071fdf960.text: Nina knew the dream. Pin the bill.

b98c3cf6ba83.speaker: ray
b98c3cf6ba83.text: That's on the string. The board wants Tuesday and tonight.

356fe14a6c9b.speaker: ray
356fe14a6c9b.text: Think, Ray. Who was holding Maureen's phone, and who did Sal write down?

f94a31f463f6.speaker: ray
f94a31f463f6.text: That's on the string. The board wants what Danny had and what he charged.

4307e3f7f48d.speaker: ray
4307e3f7f48d.text: What did Danny have, and what was he charging for it?

8c0809e8ab02.speaker: ray
8c0809e8ab02.text: An empty evidence box from under the desk. Danny's photo, the envelope, the lab receipt, the index card, the tab book photo, and the three pieces of paper on the string.

6935b0e4da71.speaker: ray
6935b0e4da71.text: An empty evidence box from under the desk. Danny's photo, the envelope, the lab receipt, the index card, the tab book photo.

6f59fb1fb9a8.speaker: ray
6f59fb1fb9a8.text: Not yet. Box, pier, backup, bait.

86619d3eadee.speaker: doyle
86619d3eadee.text: Walt drives for half the money in Century City. Car service, security, whatever's going. That doesn't make him Pryce's man.

5ef00b8a8402.speaker: doyle
5ef00b8a8402.text: That's not Walt and Pryce on paper, Ray.

3127f9b15096.speaker: doyle
3127f9b15096.text: All right. He works for Pryce. That tape's still a voice under a piano. Pryce's lawyers will find a man who swears it's an actor. You can't put Walt with Pryce the night Reyes died.

6ea20657cb12.speaker: doyle
6ea20657cb12.text: That doesn't put him in Century City on Tuesday night.

33d4dbd990e6.speaker: doyle
33d4dbd990e6.text: And Haskell? Ted Haskell is a sitting councilman. Fifty thousand in a booth is his word against a dead piano player's phone. He'll call it a campaign donation and the captain will thank him for it.

f759a6977832.speaker: doyle
f759a6977832.text: That's not Pryce and Haskell together, Ray.

62d2baf2c19f.speaker: pryce
62d2baf2c19f.text: Ted, nobody in this room is listening to anything but the music. That's why I like it here.
62d2baf2c19f.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_michael 50%, -1.5 semitones, speed 0.92, warmth 2

ab5b1ae71ab1.speaker: pryce
ab5b1ae71ab1.text: The second fifty. The rest after the vote.
ab5b1ae71ab1.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_michael 50%, -1.5 semitones, speed 0.92, warmth 2

e833655885a7.speaker: haskell
e833655885a7.text: Elliot says the hearing will be packed. The neighborhood groups, the jazz people...

8a76d976c9e0.speaker: pryce
8a76d976c9e0.text: Jazz people don't vote, Ted. They barely get up before noon.
8a76d976c9e0.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_michael 50%, -1.5 semitones, speed 0.92, warmth 2

7a1a9006dc17.speaker: brenner
7a1a9006dc17.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

d4272bf88912.speaker: pryce
d4272bf88912.text: Mr. Reyes and I have an arrangement. Eight thousand on Monday, sixteen to come, and he forgets what he heard.
d4272bf88912.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_michael 50%, -1.5 semitones, speed 0.92, warmth 2

22d96e68db13.speaker: brenner
22d96e68db13.text: He was close enough to hear, last time. He's close enough now.
22d96e68db13.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

5d639d61fa9a.speaker: brenner
5d639d61fa9a.text: You don't pay a man like that three times, Harlan. You pay him once.
5d639d61fa9a.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_santa 50%, -2 semitones, speed 0.88, warmth 2

e559730f4fe7.speaker: pryce
e559730f4fe7.voice: kokoro: am_eric 50% + am_michael 50%, -1.5 semitones, speed 0.92, warmth 2

4f0a039a2fbd.speaker: haskell
4f0a039a2fbd.text: I didn't hear that. I'm going home.
